_about: Findings of dev/check_pages.py that are known, handed to the chat that owns the page, and listed in docs/ROADMAP.md. The page check still prints them (marked 'known') but does not fail on them. Each entry: page (as the page check names it), the check, the owning chat, the date and why it waits. Remove an entry in the same change that fixes it; an entry older than 14 days is reported as overdue.

issues.why: picture() in app.js waits 20 seconds before its second try and leaves the failed picture on show meanwhile; hide it (data-failed, or a 'retrying' state) from the first failure, and show it again when the second try loads
